description: List all software you own with its id, slug, review status (pending/approved/rejected/flagged), whether it is unlisted, price and sales count. Use this to recover the software_id needed by update_software, check_review_status, set_metadata and delete_software. Unlike search_software, this also returns pending, rejected and unlisted tools. Requires CRELA_API_KEY.
name: list_my_software
title: List my Crela software
